The '''19th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 16, 2014, at the [[Santa Monica Airport#Barker Hangar|Barker Hangar]] at the [[Santa Monica Airport]], honoring the finest achievements of [[2013 in film|2013 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2014/01/critics-choice-movie-awards-unveiled-live-666047/ |title=Critics' Choice Movie Awards: '12 Years a Slave' Named Best Picture; 'Gravity' Leads Field With 7 Wins |author=The Deadline Team |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=January 16, 2014 |access-date=January 16, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2014/film/news/12-years-a-slave-takes-top-honors-at-critics-choice-movie-awards-1201061447/ |title='12 Years a Slave' Takes Top Honors at Critics' Choice Movie Awards |last=Gray |first=Tim |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 16, 2014 |access-date=January 16, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/movies/moviesnow/la-et-mn-critics-choice-12-years-slave-20140115-story.html |title=Critics' Choice Awards: '12 Years a Slave' wins for Best Film |last=King |first=Susan |work=[[Los Angeles Times]] |date=January 16, 2014 |access-date=January 16, 2014}}</ref> The ceremony was broadcast on [[The CW]] and hosted by [[Aisha Tyler]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/critics-choice-awards-draws-oscar-671769/ |title=Critics' Choice Awards Draws Oscar Nominees for an Audition, of Sorts |last=Feinberg |first=Scott |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=January 16, 2014 |access-date=January 16, 2014}}</ref> The nominees were announced on December 16, 2013.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2013/12/critics-choice-movie-awards-nominees-full-list-652803/ |title='American Hustle', '12 Years a Slave' Lead BFCA's Critics' Choice Movie Awards Nominations |last=Hammond |first=Pete |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=December 16, 2013 |access-date=December 16, 2013}}</ref>
